Hi Samantha / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the clarity on FintechCo's priorities around latency, cost predictability, and auditability for your recommendation engine workload. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

- Key takeaways: production inference at scale (30–50 qps sustained), strict data isolation for PII, SOC 2 evidence required, and a preference for predictable monthly committed capacity.
- Short-term asks from FintechCo: security questionnaire, initial perf targets, and an exec alignment call to introduce our VP-level stakeholder and make sure procurement/architecture are aligned.

Next steps I propose:
1) Exec alignment call (VP / CTO intro) — 30 min: surface commercial and risk/ops asks.
2) Technical deep dive — 60 min with Dev/infra to scope demo and benchmark tests.
3) Share mutual action plan + SOW draft (attached) for procurement timeline.

Proposed windows next week (PT): Tue 2/24 10:00–11:00am, Wed 2/25 9:00–10:30am, Thu 2/26 11:00–11:30am. If you prefer, here's our exec scheduling link: https://calendly.com/redwood-exec/30min

I've attached the Mutual Action Plan and a first-pass SOW for review. Looping in Aditya (AE) and Dev (Solutions Engineer) to coordinate the technical dive and calendar.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
